subject: Deployment & Region: MAP for CardioCore POC — Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private
messages:
From: Sarah Connors <sarah.connors@cardiocore.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@cardiocore.com
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: CardioCore MAP + initial constraints (regions, data residency)

Lauren — thanks for the demo last week. Team is excited. I attached our mutual action plan draft (MAP) and a short SOW outline. Two quick constraints from legal/procurement before we onboard infra: 1) US-only data residency for PHI, 2) SOC2 evidence and penetration test summary, and 3) flexibility to run in our VPC for regulated features.

High-level ask: can you map out the recommended path and timelines for Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private, and call out where we need contracts/attestations to be in place to keep the pilot on track for a Jan 31st go/no-go?

Attached: CardioCore_MAP_v1.2.pdf, CardioCore_SOW_draft.docx

Thanks — Sarah
Sarah Connors
Director, Clinical AI Programs | CardioCore Health
Phone: +1 415-555-0194

From: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Connors <sarah.connors@cardiocore.com>
Cc: dev_patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, rachel_kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: CardioCore MAP + initial constraints (regions, data residency)

Thanks Sarah — appreciated. Looping in Dev (solutions engineering), Rachel (CS lead) and Marcus (dedicated infra PM). We can absolutely lay out a clear MAP and decision checkpoints for Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private.

Quick note up front: Hosted (fastest time-to-value) will work for non-PHI testing if you want an early UX evaluation, but for PHI and your requirement of US-only residency + VPC connectivity, Dedicated or Private will be the recommended paths. We will produce a comparative timeline that highlights which items (procurement, SOC2, network setup, HSM/KMS approvals) must be done in parallel to hit Jan 31.

I'll get a draft MAP back to you by Fri 12/4.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Senior Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com

From: dev_patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, rachel_kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 10:27:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: Re: CardioCore MAP + initial constraints (regions, data residency)

Lauren/Rachel/Marcus — quick tech sketch:
- Hosted: quickest (1–2 weeks for a non-PHI UX proof) — uses Redwood-hosted US region (not VPC). No attestations required beyond standard SLA and SOC2 summary.
- Dedicated: reserved GPU pool in our US region + private network peering (VPC) — estimated 3–5 weeks (procurement + IP/contracting + network + staging). Requires SOC2 report, subnet peering, customer-supplied KMS key OR Redwood-managed key with dual controls.
- Private: full customer-managed control plane in their VPC / on-prem — 6–10 weeks depending on firewall/air-gap and access to on-prem resources; will need our install SOW and a professional services block.

Dependencies to call out in MAP: procurement sign-off (SOW + license), SOC2 doc + pen test summary, network whitelist & peering admin windows, and contract clause for PHI handling (BAA if needed).

I'll assemble a simple timeline + gating checklist. Marcus — can you pull current PS ETA and add resource availability?

— Dev

From: marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, rachel_kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, dev_patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 08:16:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Internal: Re: CardioCore MAP + initial constraints (regions, data residency)

Adding PS and infra availability:
- Professional Services: can commit 2 engineers (one infra, one integration) starting 12/13 for 3 weeks (block: 120 hours each) if SOW signed by 12/10.
- Dedicated capacity: we have a north-south pool in us-west-2 that can be reserved with 2–3 day notice; provisioning + testing window is 5 business days after PO and contract signature.
- Private deploy: requires an install window and PS remote time; estimate 8 weeks to fully onboard for a private VPC deployment if network approvals are slower.

I'll attach a short ETA table to the MAP draft. Marcus

From: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Connors <sarah.connors@cardiocore.com>, procurement@cardiocore.com
Cc: dev_patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, rachel_kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, partners@pipelineai.com
Date: Fri, 04 Dec 2026 15:29:00 -0800
Subject: Re: CardioCore MAP + initial constraints (regions, data residency) — draft MAP attached

Sarah / team — attached is our draft MAP (CardioCore_MAP_v1.2.pdf) and a short decision matrix. Summary:
- Recommendation: Start with a limited non-PHI Hosted pilot immediately (2 weeks) to validate UX and API integration while contracting and SOC2 evidence are processed for Dedicated.
- Parallel track: Procurement to approve SOW and PO by 12/10; upon signature we reserve Dedicated capacity (5 business days provisioning) and begin network peering/configuration.
- Alternative (Private): reserved for production go-live if you require full control; PS lead time and network gating make this a longer path (target Feb–Mar production).

Key action items (owner / due):
- CardioCore procurement: return signed SOW (owner: procurement@cardiocore.com) — due 2026-12-10
- CardioCore security: confirm SOC2/pen test acceptance criteria — due 2026-12-08
- Redwood (Lauren): finalize license terms and offer 30-day pilot discount — due 2026-12-06
- Redwood (Marcus/Dev): reserve Dedicated pool pending PO — pending SOW signature

We also attached the Redwood SOC2 summary (redwood-soc2-summary.pdf). If you're comfortable, we can schedule a technical kickoff Wed 12/15 to start integration.

Thanks, Lauren
Senior Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com
